subject: gk
question: Which of the following claims about abiotic is false?

options.text: Water is an abiotic component of the ecosystem
Abiotic components of the ecosystem were never alive
They are the non - living components of the ecosystem
They are the living components of the ecosystem

solution:
The correct answer is __**They are the living components of the ecosystem**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **claim that abiotic components are the living components of an ecosystem is false**.
 
• Abiotic components **are the non-living parts of an ecosystem. **
 
• Abiotic components **are non-living parts of an ecosystem, such as water, air, soil, rocks, light, and temperature.**
 
• Abiotic components affect the living components of an ecosystem, such as plants and animals.
 
• The** living components of an ecosystem are called biotic components.**
 
• These include plants, animals, fungi, and microscopic living organisms such as bacteria and protists.​
